checkpoints.summary: Viewport-first interaction, contextual inspection and accessibility production adapters
Lane contract oracle and exact-source browser journey harness

productionDelta: Explore receives a viewport-first presentation ratio on desktop while preserving the existing workspace and bootstrap owners.
A contextual viewport dock exposes Inspect selection and Evidence / Lab without making panels the sole journey.
Pointer, tap, wheel, pinch and keyboard observations are traced around the frozen input router; the lane does not consume or reroute native input.
Keyboard I opens contextual Inspect and Escape returns focus to the Explore viewport.
Compact layout exports measured bottom-sheet safe space so contextual and semantic-scale controls can settle above the fixed sheet.
Skip links, focus visibility, roving workspace tabs, active-panel accessibility state, reduced motion, increased contrast, forced colors and text scaling are additive presentation behavior.

beforeAfter.before: Frozen base had the shared direct-input/scale/selection owners and mobile sheet, but no V1X-10 contextual viewport dock, lane-level no-occlusion telemetry, skip-link layer, or V1X-10 bounded modality trace.
beforeAfter.after: V1X-10 adds those presentation and accessibility layers through additive component discovery without modifying the central bootstrap, camera, scale, selection, scene, rendering or scientific-provider authorities.
